selection_approach_display: Lancaster checks academic requirements and the SJT filter before ranking eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total within the relevant applicant pool.

course.name: Medicine and Surgery MBChB
course.notes: Five-year standard-entry A100. Graduates apply through A100 rather than a separate graduate-entry course. A104 and A900 are separate widening-participation routes and are not executable through this profile.

medical_school.name: Lancaster Medical School
medical_school.notes: Production rules are mapped from the supplied Lancaster A100 research pack and its official first-party sources.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive total against the Home non-contextual boundary.
University-verified contextual applicants use the lower contextual UCAT boundary.
International applicants are ranked separately and had four places for 2026 entry.
Graduates apply through A100 and use the applicable fee-status UCAT pool, but their full academic eligibility requires transcript and prior-qualification review.

overall_policy.description: Applicants pass an academic eligibility stage before UCAT ranking. The automated scope covers complete standard A-level school-leaver profiles; cross-qualification science conditions, exceptional-circumstances resits, graduate transcripts and unlisted international equivalences require review.
not_eligible_if: The applicable academic minimum requirements are not met.
UCAT is not taken in the application cycle.
A GCSE resit is presented without a university-approved exceptional-circumstances route.
The applicant seeks transfer from another degree or medical programme outside Lancaster's narrowly defined restart exception.

grade_requirements.notes: Only IGCSE English as a First Language is accepted for the IGCSE English requirement.

conditional_grade_requirements.condition: Required where Biology is not studied at A-level, IB Higher Level or Advanced Higher.
Required where Chemistry is not studied at A-level, IB Higher Level or Advanced Higher.

requirements: At least 13 points from the best eight GCSEs.
Biology, Chemistry and Physics separately or Combined Science: Trilogy at 6/B.
The conditional Biology and Chemistry grade-7 rule where the subject is absent at higher level.

accepted_equivalencies: IGCSE, with English as a First Language required for the English condition
Combined Science: Trilogy as two GCSEs
gcse.notes: The 13-point GCSE score is a minimum academic gate and is not blended with UCAT ranking.

stage_1_predicted_minimum.notes: Predicted at least AAB is required to progress through Stage 1. This is separate from the eventual standard offer.

grade_requirements.notes: Stage 1 predicted-grade gate for interview consideration.
A-level resits normally require A*AA within three years and first-attempt grades of at least ABB. Exceptional-circumstances cases require review.

standard_offer.notes: The evidenced alternative is AAB where a fourth AS/A-level subject or EPQ is presented.

contextual_offer.notes: Final contextual offer after successful interview; it does not replace the Stage 1 academic screen.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: Any two of the three named subjects.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Any third full A level is accepted subject to the published exclusions. General Studies and Critical Thinking may only be a fourth subject.
a_level.notes: The official evidence supplied does not state a science practical-endorsement requirement, so none is enforced.

grade_requirements.notes: No separate total-points threshold was supplied; all three HL subjects require 6 and all three SL subjects require 5.

ib.notes: IB profiles require review until the engine can enforce the published no-total-points route and all Standard Level conditions without inventing a total.

higher_offer.notes: Five Highers at one sitting after one year, with Biology and Chemistry both at A.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Biology and Chemistry, both at A, at one sitting after one year.

scottish.notes: National 5 English and Mathematics require A or B. Full route eligibility requires review of timing and subject-specific grades.

degree.notes: Graduates are not currently eligible for the contextual/WP adjustment.

international_qualifications.notes: Country-specific requirements remain in Lancaster's annually updated International Qualifications fact sheet and are not inferred.

post_16.notes: Only qualification routes with complete represented evidence may receive automatic eligibility. Other evidenced routes remain visible but require review.

ucat.notes: No 2027 fixed threshold is encoded. The 2026-entry pool thresholds are historical guidance only.

sjt.notes: Band 4 is excluded. Bands 1 to 3 pass the SJT gate; SJT is not numerically blended into UCAT ranking.

conditions: A-level resit applicants normally require A*AA within three years of study.
First-attempt A-level grades normally must be at least ABB.
First-attempt BBB to CCC may be reviewed only with evidenced exceptional circumstances.
GCSE resits are not considered without clearly evidenced exceptional circumstances.
resits.notes: No unsupported resit assumption is made.

exemptions: Five or more years of continuous UK residence
First language English plus citizenship or residence in a UKVI-recognised majority English-speaking country
Significant UK education while now resident abroad
UK degree graduate continuously resident in the UK since graduation
english_language.notes: Exemptions and PTE evidence require manual verification; the shared automated route supports complete IELTS Academic evidence.

work_experience.notes: Relevant experience is expected but need not be clinical shadowing.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Enhanced DBS, occupational health and immunisation checks apply. No numeric minimum age was supplied.

ranking_factors.notes: Sole numeric ranking factor after academic and SJT gates.

score_components.notes: No GCSE or A-level score is blended after Stage 1.

total_score.notes: Applicants are ranked within the applicable pool.

calculation.notes: The model is fully representable as a UCAT ranking after pass/fail academic and SJT gates.

thresholds.notes: The 2027 live boundary is unknown. The 2026-entry threshold of 1920 is retained only as historical guidance.
The 2027 live contextual boundary is unknown. The 2026-entry threshold of 1870 is historical guidance.
The 2027 live overseas boundary is unknown. The 2026-entry threshold of 1900 is historical guidance.

selection_adjustments.notes: Only verified programme completion plus all A100 academic and WP conditions activates this rule.

output_band_policy.notes: Configured numeric bands use only published 2026-entry thresholds and the evidenced 10-point borderline interval as historical guidance. No unsupported strong-choice boundary is invented.

domains: responses to written or video prompts

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Academic screening is pass/fail. UCAT cognitive total alone ranks eligible applicants for interview within separate Home standard, Home contextual and International pools.

criteria.description: Care experience or care-leaver status of at least three months, or refugee status, qualifies automatically subject to Lancaster verification.
Otherwise at least two published widening-participation criteria are required, including supported neighbourhood, household-income, bursary and related evidence categories.
criteria.notes: The full evidence list is university-verified; ApplySmart does not infer eligibility from a postcode alone.

adjustments.policy_description: Use the separate lower contextual UCAT boundary after Lancaster verifies contextual status.
adjustments.notes: The 1870 value is the 2026-entry historical boundary, not a guaranteed 2027 cutoff.

adjustments.policy_description: Eligible applicants who succeed at interview may receive ABB rather than AAA.
adjustments.notes: Stored as policy context only; ApplySmart does not predict offers.

conditions: Lancaster Access Programme Access to Medicine completion is verified.
A100 academic entry requirements are met.
The applicable widening-participation criteria are met.
guaranteed_interview_rules.notes: Ordinary contextual status alone does not guarantee an interview.

contextual_admissions.notes: Graduates are not currently eligible for contextual/WP consideration. International contextual adjustments are not evidenced and are not applied.

ranking_pools.name: Home non-contextual UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: The stated 130 Home places are for 2026 entry, with at least 115 guaranteed after A104 progression is accounted for. This is not treated as a future fixed capacity.

ranking_pools.name: Home contextual UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: A lower annual boundary applies; no separate contextual places quota is inferred.

ranking_pools.name: International UCAT ranking pool
ranking_pools.notes: Four places were published for 2026 entry. No future fixed quota is inferred.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

offer_selection.interview_format: Online Multiple Mini Interview via Microsoft Teams for 2026 entry; stations are mostly five minutes.

interview_scoring.notes: Each station is scored by a trained interviewer against defined criteria. The station count, scale and minimum standard are not published.

offer_selection.offer_model: Applicants with the highest overall MMI scores receive offers. UCAT and GCSE results are not carried into this ranking.
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: A reserve list may operate from the UCAS decision deadline until the start of term. Applicants accepting another offer or requesting deferred entry are excluded.

standard_offer.notes: AAB may apply with a fourth AS/A level or EPQ under the published rule.

contextual_offer.notes: For university-verified eligible WP applicants who succeed at interview.

offer_selection.notes: Post-interview information is stored for transparency only. ApplySmart does not produce an offer prediction.

cycles.notes: Application statistics combine all Home A100 applicants; contextual status is separated only in the UCAT table. Values remain on the historical /3600 scale.
Contextual application counts were not separately published.
Lancaster cautions that application fee status is not confirmed until interview, so the International application count may overstate the final group.
Partial in-progress cycle data. A small pool up to 10 points below the threshold was also invited using prior academic performance.
Partial in-progress cycle data. A small pool up to 10 points below the threshold was also invited using prior academic performance.
Partial in-progress cycle data; interviewed and offer-holder averages were not yet published.

historical_admissions.scale_policy: The 2025 figures remain on /3600 and the 2026 figures remain on /2700. No linear conversion is used for prediction because the research explicitly warns that the scales must not be compared directly.
historical_admissions.notes: Only 2026-entry /2700 pool thresholds and the published 10-point Home borderline interval feed the interview-band configuration, and only as historical guidance.

engine_notes.approved_activation_scope: Complete standard A-level school-leaver profiles in the Home standard, university-verified Home contextual/WP and International pools, using academic and SJT gates followed by historical UCAT guidance. Other published routes remain metadata-backed review paths.
engine_notes.prediction_scope: Medium-confidence historical guidance using official 2026-entry /2700 thresholds for Home standard, Home contextual/WP and International school-leaver pools. The 10-point borderline interval is shown as ambitious guidance and not as an automatic invitation.
course_specific_notes: GCSE points are an eligibility gate only; UCAT cognitive total is the sole interview-ranking metric.
SJT Band 4 is excluded, while Bands 1 to 3 pass the filter.
Home standard, Home contextual and International applicants use separate historical guidance pools.
A small Home pool up to 10 UCAT points below the 2026 threshold was invited using prior academic performance; ApplySmart labels that interval as ambitious historical guidance.
Graduates apply through A100 but do not receive contextual/WP consideration.
